# AI Atlas

> The deterministic decision engine and verified stack builder for artificial intelligence tools.

AI Atlas solves tool selection paralysis by matching user goals directly to verified AI software, models, and multi-step execution workflows. Every tool's capability, pricing tier, and platform compatibility is strictly verified to eliminate hallucinations.

## Core Capabilities

- Natural Language Goal Search: Convert ambiguous user goals into complete AI execution blueprints.
- Verified AI Tool Directory: 1,000+ fact-verified tools categorized across 16 foundational domains.
- AI Stack Builder: Combine specialized tools, calculate true monthly subscription costs, and eliminate duplicate feature spend.
- Side-by-Side Comparison: Direct factual matrix evaluating pricing, developer APIs, strengths, and tradeoffs.
- Curated AI Workflows: Proven production blueprints connecting disparate tools into automated pipelines.
- Multimodal Live Execution: Generate initial deliverables via Kie.ai multimodal generation engine.

## Taxonomy & Deep Domains

- AI Coding & IDEs: Agentic code editors, CLI tools, repository reasoning engines.
- AI Writing & Content: Copywriting, document analysis, factual research assistants.
- AI Video & Motion: Diffusion video generators, lip-sync engines, automated video editors.
- AI Audio & Voice: Hyper-realistic voice clones, generative music composition, speech-to-text.
- AI Design & 3D: High-resolution image synthesis, UI mockups, 3D asset generation.
- Autonomous Agents: Computer-use agents, multi-agent frameworks, task runners.
- Research & Science: Deep document reasoning, literature review, citation verification.
- Automation & Connectors: Workflow automation, web scraping, deterministic API pipelines.
